title: Glokzin Teal Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mounted Oval Combination Caddy, Concealed Screw Mount, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Glokzin Teal, shower basket for bathroom shower storage with solid brass construction and wall mount installation, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Size: 18.75 inches long (18.75-inch, 18.75 in), 2.25 inches high (2.25-inch, 2.25 in), 4.13 inches wide/projection (4.13-inch, 4.13 in). This oval combination shower basket / shower caddy uses rust proof solid brass wires that will never rust, plus a designer finish for corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Concealed screw mounting system creates a clean look; wall-mounted design saves space in the bath or shower. Includes basket and all installation hardware; no assembly required. Traditional style suited to traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
